svg.text: resample 7.267 s = range gather 5.212 + CT#1 2.064 TOTAL 18.45 s
Window is fused into the FFT-1 feeder and detect into the FFT-2 unloader: neither has a kernel.
CT#2 is dashed because it has no wall-clock line of its own: with OVLMODE=1 it is strip-pipelined UNDER FFT-2
(fft2_ct_overlap), so the stage timer attributes the merged time to FFT-2.
NAMING TRAP: the code calls FFT-1 `rangeFFT` and FFT-2 `azFFT` — inverted. The labels above are the PHYSICAL axes.
